rubric.role_summary: Deep learning engineer developing and deploying computer vision and multimodal models for autonomous drones, using visual and sensor data and optimizing models for embedded hardware.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Deep learning engineer developing and deploying computer vision and multimodal models for autonomous drones, using visual and sensor data and optimizing models for embedded hardware.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- M.S. or Ph.D. in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related discipline.
- Hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying deep learning models.
- Proficiency in Python/PyTorch.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- C++ coding ability.
- Ability to deliver well-architected code using Python/PyTorch.
- Ability to apply academic papers and literature to engineering work.
- Ability to work and deliver within a complex codebase.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
